title: SAGE: Hierarchical LLM-Based Literary Evaluation through Ontology-Grounded Interpretive Dimensions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated within the LLM-as-a-judge framework using an iterative 'Projection Bias Check' (self-reflection prompt) and an independent validator to detect if the evaluator inappropriately imposed Western emotional display norms or Western existentialist philosophical frameworks onto texts from non-Western traditions.

Assessed via a multi-round self-reflection process where the LLM reviews its own initial assessments to identify if it inappropriately penalized restrained emotional expression, equated explicit philosophical discourse with depth, or assumed dark/tragic themes are inherently more profound.
